widgets.markdown:
## MFA and passkey adoption
Who has registered a passkey, who has only app or phone MFA, and who has no MFA at all, across every user. A passkey here is a device-bound passkey (`passKeyDeviceBound`, `passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator`). The company chart groups by `extensionAttribute1` when it is set, otherwise `companyName`, and leaves out users with neither.

query.text:
let passkey = dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound", "passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator"]);
let app = dynamic(["microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "softwareOneTimePasscode"]);
reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| extend
    hasHardwareKey = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, passkey)) > 0,
    hasAuthenticatorApp = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, app)) > 0,
    hasNoMFA = array_length(methodsRegistered) == 0
| extend PRFMA = iif(hasHardwareKey, "Passkey", iif(hasNoMFA, "No MFA", "Missing passkey"))
| summarize Passkey = round(100.0 * countif(hasHardwareKey) / count(), 1)

widgets.title: Missing passkey or MFA, by company

query.text:
let passkey = dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound", "passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator"]);
let app = dynamic(["microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "softwareOneTimePasscode"]);
reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| extend
    hasHardwareKey = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, passkey)) > 0,
    hasAuthenticatorApp = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, app)) > 0,
    hasNoMFA = array_length(methodsRegistered) == 0
| join kind = inner (
    users
    | extend company = iif(isnotempty(tostring(onPremisesExtensionAttributes.extensionAttribute1)), tolower(tostring(onPremisesExtensionAttributes.extensionAttribute1)), tolower(companyName))
    | where isnotempty(company)
    | project id, company)
    on id
| extend PRFMA = iif(hasHardwareKey, "Passkey", iif(hasNoMFA, "No MFA", "Missing passkey"))
| where PRFMA <> "Passkey"
| summarize count() by PRFMA, company
| where count_ > {MinUsers}

query.text:
let passkey = dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound", "passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator"]);
let app = dynamic(["microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "softwareOneTimePasscode"]);
reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| extend
    hasHardwareKey = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, passkey)) > 0,
    hasAuthenticatorApp = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, app)) > 0,
    hasNoMFA = array_length(methodsRegistered) == 0
| extend PRFMA = iif(hasHardwareKey, "Passkey", iif(hasNoMFA, "No MFA", "Missing passkey"))
| summarize Users = count() by PRFMA

let passkey = dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound", "passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator"]);
let app = dynamic(["microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "softwareOneTimePasscode"]);
reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| extend
    hasHardwareKey = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, passkey)) > 0,
    hasAuthenticatorApp = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, app)) > 0,
    hasNoMFA = array_length(methodsRegistered) == 0
| extend PRFMA = iif(hasHardwareKey, "Passkey", iif(hasNoMFA, "No MFA", "Missing passkey"))
| summarize Passkey = countif(hasHardwareKey), AuthenticatorApp = countif(hasAuthenticatorApp), PasswordlessCapable = countif(isPasswordlessCapable), NoMFA = countif(hasNoMFA)

reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| mv-expand method = methodsRegistered
| summarize Users = count() by Method = tostring(method)
| order by Users desc

let passkey = dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound", "passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator"]);
let app = dynamic(["microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "softwareOneTimePasscode"]);
reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| extend
    hasHardwareKey = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, passkey)) > 0,
    hasAuthenticatorApp = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, app)) > 0,
    hasNoMFA = array_length(methodsRegistered) == 0
| extend PRFMA = iif(hasHardwareKey, "Passkey", iif(hasNoMFA, "No MFA", "Missing passkey"))
| where isAdmin and not(hasHardwareKey)
| project userDisplayName, userPrincipalName, defaultMfaMethod, methodsRegistered
| order by userDisplayName asc

let passkey = dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound", "passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator"]);
let app = dynamic(["microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "softwareOneTimePasscode"]);
reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| extend
    hasHardwareKey = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, passkey)) > 0,
    hasAuthenticatorApp = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, app)) > 0,
    hasNoMFA = array_length(methodsRegistered) == 0
| extend PRFMA = iif(hasHardwareKey, "Passkey", iif(hasNoMFA, "No MFA", "Missing passkey"))
| where PRFMA <> "Passkey"
| project userDisplayName, userPrincipalName, PRFMA, hasAuthenticatorApp, defaultMfaMethod, methodsRegistered
| order by PRFMA asc, userDisplayName asc

auditLogs_signIns
| where createdDateTime > ago({Period})
| mv-expand detail = authenticationDetails
| where tobool(detail.succeeded)
| extend Method = tostring(detail.authenticationMethod)
| where Method in ({MfaTypes})
| summarize SignIns = count() by bin(createdDateTime, iff({Period} <= 1d, 1h, 1d)), Method
